title: Clinical Fellowship 2027 — European Academy of Neurology
duration: Minimum 6 weeks, maximum 12 weeks, at a minimum of 5 days per week
description: The EAN Clinical Fellowship funds a clinical observational placement of six to twelve weeks at an approved EAN host neurological department outside the applicant's country of residence, at EUR 425 per week plus up to EUR 300 of travel costs reimbursed after the fellowship. The programme is designed for neurologists who are still training or have recently qualified, and the total annual budget supports 300 fellowship weeks. title: ERS Visiting Mid-Career Investigator Travel (VISIT) Grant
program_type: Professional association international visit and networking grant
description: The ERS Visiting Mid-Career Investigator Travel (VISIT) Grant offers mid-career investigators, clinicians and allied healthcare professionals who are transitioning to more established stages of their careers the chance to visit an institution outside their home country for up to one month, in order to establish a professional relationship, network or collaboration and to gain insights, strengthen competencies and knowledge that help improve clinical and research-related competencies.

title: Research Fellowship 2027 — European Academy of Neurology
duration: Research Training Fellowship: typically 12 months, minimum 6. Research Experience Fellowship: typically 6 months, minimum 3
description: The EAN Research Fellowship supports European neurologists to carry out research at an academic neurological department outside their country of residence, at EUR 2,000 per month plus up to EUR 500 of travel costs reimbursed after the fellowship. It runs two tracks: Research Training Fellowships of typically 12 months and no less than six months, and Research Experience Fellowships of typically six months and no less than three months. title: Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study Fellowships 2027/28
description: The Gulbenkian Institute for Advanced Study in Lisbon awards fellowships to international academics, emeriti, independent scholars and artists for residencies of three to eight months to work on projects of their own choosing. Each fellowship includes travel expenses, travel and health insurance, a monthly stipend and a partial housing allowance. Applications for the 2027/28 cycle are open from 1 July 2026 until 15 October 2026 at 15:00 Lisbon time, and offers are made from late January of the following year.

title: FWO Junior Postdoctoral Fellowship
duration: 3 years, no extension possible; start on 1 October or 1 November 2027
description: The FWO junior postdoctoral fellowship supports researchers who have recently obtained their doctorate to further specialise in their research discipline, develop their own research line while acquiring additional academic skills through training and mobility, giving young researchers optimal opportunities to build an independent international research career, either within an academic context or beyond.

title: International Student Leadership Award (ISLA) - Fall
description: The International Student Leadership Award (ISLA) - Fall is a Toronto Metropolitan University entrance scholarship for undergraduate international students enrolling in a post-secondary institution for the first time, recognising students who do well academically, volunteer, join clubs and show leadership qualities; it has a value of $10,000 CAD with up to 53 recipients for fall 2027 and is entrance-only and non-renewable.

title: Beca al Talento Académico Internacional
duration: Entrance scholarship for a professional degree beginning in August 2027, subject to annual conservation requirements
description: The Beca al Talento Académico Internacional is the Tecnológico de Monterrey scholarship for international applicants, reserved for candidates coming from secondary schools in a named group of Latin American and Caribbean countries. It recognises students with an outstanding academic record and can award support of between 40% and 60% of the tuition cost, valid for the campus to which the applicant has been admitted.
